abort: first unmet correctness/numerical/resource condition; retain failure; do not resample or tune acceptance
budget: 3 sequential runs, 600 s and 8 GiB peak RSS each; hard wall 1200 s; zero API/GPU spend
cheaper_alternative: Six source-level regression cases first; they all fail on main 467ff55
decision: merge minimal provenance fix only after actual-model checks, CI and independent review pass
device: cpu fp32, one torch thread; adapter serializes one shared model
evaluation: fresh disjoint prompt IDs; separate SHA-256-mod-7 synthetic criterion; separate checkpoint consumer verifies outputs
hypothesis: RVL generation provenance must bind verified response and active loaded policy version before GRPO consumption; accumulated RVL gradients/updates must match an independent full-graph equation
null_control: one constant-reward group each round; all groups constant in last round with populated Adam moments
objective: RVL token-mean PPO-clipped group-relative objective, epsilon 1e-6; AdamW lr 1e-4 with historical default decay 0.01
promotion: diagnostic tie permitted, except every fourth round requires gain 1.1 to force rejection; never a capability acceptance rule
recovery: existing RVL save/restore, exact next GRPO update; do not reimplement unmerged #69 SIGKILL runner
scope: Systems correctness with a pretrained toy causal LM; no new RL method or capability test
